title: Auri Pack
description: Makes iron into Auri, more Auri is good for lifestyle
body:
Makes all iron into irauri, this has many benefits to the user experience:
- Every time you see totem, you see auri
- Every starter iron armor you have, you see auri
- Works well for colorblind friends
- Keeps zoobers out with irauri door
- You can now go mining for irauri
- Cake is now auri
